title: Privileged role assigned directly to a user rather than through a group

report.title: {Items.Count} privileged {Plural(Items.Count, 'role is', 'roles are')} assigned directly to a user

messages.businessImpact: Direct assignments are easy to grant and easy to forget, so they accumulate and are missed when someone changes role or leaves.
remediation: Assign through role-assignable groups so membership is reviewable in one place.
